test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F is sitting second to the left of A. E is an immediate neighbour of F. C sits second to the right of D. B sits to the immediate left of E. Who is sitting second to the left of B?
solution: Given: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) F is sitting second to the left of A. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2712c7514c20bdf089c153babda6114e621e690a77e4f0f5865b60d47df39018.png] 2) E is an immediate neighbour of F.
